```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
plot_loess_residuals <- function(test_df, active_site_positions,
                                 span = 0.7, protein_name = "") {
  
  # Filter out active site positions
  test_df_fil <- test_df %>% filter(!new_position %in% active_site_positions)
  
  # Fit loess model on filtered data (using the inverted ESM.1v)
  loess_fit <- loess(ESM.1v ~ ddG_pred, data = test_df_fil, span = span, family = "symmetric")
  
  # Predict on all data
  test_df$fitted_pred <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = test_df)
  test_df$residuals_pred <- test_df$ESM.1v - test_df$fitted_pred
  
  # Fit line data for the smooth curve
  fit_line_df <- data.frame(
    ddG_pred = seq(0,
                   max(test_df$ddG_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
                   length.out = 200)
  )
  fit_line_df$ESM.1v <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = fit_line_df)
  
  # Spearman correlation (will reflect the inverted relationship)
  spearman_result <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(test_df$ddG_pred, test_df$ESM.1v, method = "spearman"))
  spearman_rho <- spearman_result$estimate
  spearman_p <- spearman_result$p.value
  
  # Axis and color scale limits
  xlim_vals <- range(test_df$ddG_pred, na.rm = TRUE)
  ylim_vals <- range(test_df$ESM.1v, na.rm = TRUE)
  resid_limit <- max(abs(test_df$residuals_pred), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Main plot
  p <- ggplot(test_df, aes(x = ddG_pred , y = ESM.1v, color = residuals_pred)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_line(data = fit_line_df, aes(x = ddG_pred, y = ESM.1v),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(protein_name, ": ", nrow(test_df), " mutations"),
      subtitle = paste0("Spearman's rho = ", round(spearman_rho, 2)),
      x = "ThermoMPNN predicted ddGf",
      y = "ESM.1v",  # Updated label to reflect the inversion
      color = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    xlim(xlim_vals) +
    ylim(ylim_vals) +
    scale_color_gradient2(
      low = "red", mid = "grey", high = "blue", midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-resid_limit, resid_limit), name = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  # Add marginal density plots
  p_marginal <- ggMarginal(
    p,
    type = "density",
    margins = "both",
    groupColour = FALSE,
    groupFill = FALSE,
    size = 10,
    colour = "grey",
    fill = "lightgrey"
  )
  
  return(list(
    plot = p_marginal,
    data = test_df
  ))
}

df_residual <- plot_loess_residuals(
  df, 
  active_site_positions = c(), 
  protein_name = "A0A075B6X5"
)

p1 <- df_residual$plot
p1
```

```{r}
# 1. Load PDB (Ensure this path is correct)
pdb <- read.pdb("~/Downloads/AF-A0A075B6X5-F1-model_v6.pdb", rm.alt = TRUE)
# 2. Define Active Sites
active_site_resnos <- c(45:50, 68:73, 105:111)

# 3. Get Active Site Coordinates (Using the CORRECT 'string' argument)
# This was likely the missing piece in your previous environment
site_inds <- atom.select(pdb, resno = active_site_resnos, string = "noh")
site_xyz <- pdb$xyz[site_inds$xyz]

# Check immediately
if (length(site_inds$atom) == 0) {
  stop("STOP: Active site atoms are 0. The Code will not work.")
} else {
  print(paste("Active Site Loaded: Found", length(site_inds$atom), "atoms."))
}

# 4. Redefine the Function (The Robust Version)
calc_min_heavy_dist <- function(res_num, pdb_obj, site_coords) {
  
  # Bio3D is strict: 'resno' must be numeric. 
  # We force it here to fix the error you saw in Test B.
  res_num <- as.numeric(as.character(res_num))
  
  # Use 'string = "noh"' (The fix confirmed by Test A)
  target_inds <- atom.select(pdb_obj, resno = res_num, string = "noh")
  
  # Safety catch for missing residues
  if (length(target_inds$atom) == 0) return(NA)
  
  # Calculate
  target_xyz <- pdb_obj$xyz[target_inds$xyz]
  t_mat <- matrix(target_xyz, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  s_mat <- matrix(site_coords, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  return(min(dist.xyz(t_mat, s_mat), na.rm = TRUE))
}

# 5. Run Calculation
unique_positions <- unique(plotting_data$mutation_position)

print("Starting calculation loop...")

dist_vals <- sapply(unique_positions, function(x) {
  calc_min_heavy_dist(x, pdb, site_xyz)
})

# 6. Map Back Safely
# explicitly name the vector to ensure matching works
names(dist_vals) <- as.character(unique_positions) 

plotting_data <- df_residual$data
# Assign based on character matching
plotting_data$min_dist_to_site <- dist_vals[as.character(plotting_data$new_position)]

# 7. Final Result
print(paste("Final NAs:", sum(is.na(plotting_data$min_dist_to_site))))
head(plotting_data$min_dist_to_site)

# If NAs remain, it means those specific residues are missing from the PDB structure 
# (common in loop regions), which is normal.
# Filter out NAs (residues not found in PDB structure)
plotting_data <- plotting_data %>% filter(!is.na(min_dist_to_site))
nrow(plotting_data) #
plotting_data
```


```{r}
# --- Merge with prediction data ---
# Ensure 'gck_pred_residual' is loaded or replaced with your IGHV3-7 data
merged_df <- plotting_data %>%
  filter(residuals_pred <= 0)

# --- Residue-level median residuals ---
merged_df_residue <- merged_df %>%
  group_by(new_position) %>%
  summarise(loess_residual_avg = median(residuals_pred, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(plotting_data, by = "new_position" )

# --- Exclude the binding sites themselves for fitting ---
# (Replacing the previous 'orthosteric_sites' logic)
merged_df_residue_fil <- merged_df_residue %>%
  filter(!new_position %in% active_site_resnos)

# --- Fit exponential model ---
exp_model <- nlsLM(
  abs(loess_residual_avg) ~ a * exp(-b * min_dist_to_site),
  data = merged_df_residue_fil,
  start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1)
)
exp_model

# --- Prediction grid ---
x_vals <- seq(min(merged_df_residue_fil$min_dist_to_site, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(merged_df_residue_fil$min_dist_to_site, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 200)

# --- Bootstrapping for confidence intervals ---
set.seed(11)
boot_params <- replicate(1000, {
  samp <- merged_df_residue_fil[sample(nrow(merged_df_residue_fil), replace = TRUE), ]
  fit <- try(nlsLM(abs(loess_residual_avg) ~ a * exp(-b * min_dist_to_site),
                   data = samp, start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1)), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) c(NA, NA) else coef(fit)
})
boot_params <- t(boot_params)[complete.cases(t(boot_params)), ]

boot_preds <- apply(boot_params, 1, function(p) p[1] * exp(-p[2] * x_vals))

fit_df_residue <- data.frame(
  min_dist_to_site = x_vals,
  loess_residual_pred = predict(exp_model, newdata = data.frame(min_dist_to_site = x_vals)),
  lower = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  upper = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
)

# --- Model parameter extraction and derived quantity ---
model_summary <- summary(exp_model)
coefs <- coef(exp_model)
se <- model_summary$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]

residue_a <- c(coefs["a"],
               coefs["a"] - 1.96 * se["a"],
               coefs["a"] + 1.96 * se["a"])

residue_b <- c(coefs["b"],
               coefs["b"] - 1.96 * se["b"],
               coefs["b"] + 1.96 * se["b"])

half_d <- log(2) / coefs["b"]
half_d_ci <- quantile(log(2) / boot_params[, "b"], probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
residue_half_d <- c(half_d, half_d_ci)

cat("Parameter a (intercept):", residue_a, "\n")
cat("Parameter b (decay rate):", residue_b, "\n")
cat("Half-distance (log(2)/b):", residue_half_d, "\n")
```
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
# --- Annotate site types ---
merged_df_residue <- merged_df_residue %>%
  mutate(site_type = if_else(new_position %in% active_site_resnos, "orthosteric", "non-orthosteric"))

# --- Plot ---
orange_labs <- active_site_resnos
cyan_labs <- c()
all_labs <- union(orange_labs, cyan_labs)

p2 <- ggplot(merged_df_residue, aes(x = min_dist_to_site, y = abs(loess_residual_avg))) +

  # Unlabeled points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue, !new_position %in% all_labs),
             aes(color = site_type), size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +

  # CI ribbon
  geom_ribbon(
  data = fit_df_residue,
  aes(x = min_dist_to_site, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "grey70",
  alpha = 0.3) +

  # Main fit line
  geom_line(
  data = fit_df_residue,
  aes(x = min_dist_to_site, y = loess_residual_pred),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "black")+


  # Labeled orange points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue, new_position %in% orange_labs),
             shape = 16, size = 2, color = "orange") +
  # Labeled cyan points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue, new_position %in% cyan_labs),
             shape = 17, size = 3, color = "cyan3") +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(merged_df_residue, new_position %in% cyan_labs),
                  aes(label = new_position), color = "black") +

  # Reference line
  geom_vline(xintercept = max(merged_df_residue %>% filter(site_type == "orthosteric") %>% pull(min_dist_to_site)),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "slategrey") +

  # Labels and theme
  labs(
    title = "A0A075B6X5",
    subtitle = "",
    x = "Minimal distance to orthosteric sites",
    y = "|Median ESM1v-ddGf residual|"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("non-orthosteric" = "darkgreen", "orthosteric" = "orange")) 
p2
```

```{r}
boot_params <- t(boot_params)[complete.cases(t(boot_params)), ]

boot_preds <- apply(boot_params, 1, function(p) p[1] * exp(-p[2] * x_vals))

fit_df_residue <- data.frame(
  min_dist_to_site = x_vals,
  loess_residual_pred = predict(exp_model, newdata = data.frame(min_dist_to_site = x_vals)),
  lower = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  upper = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
)

# --- Model parameter extraction and derived quantity ---
model_summary <- summary(exp_model)
coefs <- coef(exp_model)
se <- model_summary$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]

residue_a <- c(coefs["a"],
               coefs["a"] - 1.96 * se["a"],
               coefs["a"] + 1.96 * se["a"])

residue_b <- c(coefs["b"],
               coefs["b"] - 1.96 * se["b"],
               coefs["b"] + 1.96 * se["b"])

half_d <- log(2) / coefs["b"]
half_d_ci <- quantile(log(2) / boot_params[, "b"], probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
residue_half_d <- c(half_d, half_d_ci)

cat("Parameter a (intercept):", residue_a, "\n")
cat("Parameter b (decay rate):", residue_b, "\n")
cat("Half-distance (log(2)/b):", residue_half_d, "\n")
```

```{r}
plotting_data <- df_residual$data
plotting_data
# 1. Load PDB (Ensure this path is correct)
pdb <- read.pdb("~/Downloads/AF-A0A0A6YYK6-F1-model_v6.pdb", rm.alt =  TRUE)

# 2. Define Active Sites
active_site_resnos <- c(27:38, 56:65, 90:102)

# 3. Get Active Site Coordinates (Using the CORRECT 'string' argument)
# This was likely the missing piece in your previous environment
site_inds <- atom.select(pdb, resno = active_site_resnos, string = "noh")
site_xyz <- pdb$xyz[site_inds$xyz]

# Check immediately
if (length(site_inds$atom) == 0) {
  stop("STOP: Active site atoms are 0. The Code will not work.")
} else {
  print(paste("Active Site Loaded: Found", length(site_inds$atom), "atoms."))
}

# 4. Redefine the Function (The Robust Version)
calc_min_heavy_dist <- function(res_num, pdb_obj, site_coords) {
  
  # Bio3D is strict: 'resno' must be numeric. 
  # We force it here to fix the error you saw in Test B.
  res_num <- as.numeric(as.character(res_num))
  
  # Use 'string = "noh"' (The fix confirmed by Test A)
  target_inds <- atom.select(pdb_obj, resno = res_num, string = "noh")
  
  # Safety catch for missing residues
  if (length(target_inds$atom) == 0) return(NA)
  
  # Calculate
  target_xyz <- pdb_obj$xyz[target_inds$xyz]
  t_mat <- matrix(target_xyz, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  s_mat <- matrix(site_coords, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  return(min(dist.xyz(t_mat, s_mat), na.rm = TRUE))
}

# 5. Run Calculation
unique_positions <- unique(plotting_data$new_position)

print("Starting calculation loop...")

dist_vals <- sapply(unique_positions, function(x) {
  calc_min_heavy_dist(x, pdb, site_xyz)
})

# 6. Map Back Safely
# explicitly name the vector to ensure matching works
names(dist_vals) <- as.character(unique_positions) 

# Assign based on character matching
plotting_data$min_dist_to_site <- dist_vals[as.character(plotting_data$new_position)]

# 7. Final Result
print(paste("Final NAs:", sum(is.na(plotting_data$min_dist_to_site))))
head(plotting_data$min_dist_to_site)

# If NAs remain, it means those specific residues are missing from the PDB structure 
# (common in loop regions), which is normal.
# Filter out NAs (residues not found in PDB structure)
plotting_data <- plotting_data %>% filter(!is.na(min_dist_to_site))
nrow(plotting_data) #
plotting_data
```
